-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

create-workbook.name: create-workbook
create-workbook.description: Create a new, empty Excel workbook in OneDrive. Fails if a file already exists at that path unless overwrite is set. This is not a workbook API call: it uploads an empty .xlsx, after which the workbook endpoints become available on that item. Returns the drive item, whose id addresses every other Excel tool.

params.name: File name for the new workbook. ".xlsx" is appended if missing. Pass a literal name, not a pre-encoded one.
params.parentPath: Destination folder path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Finance". Defaults to the drive root. Pass literal folder names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.overwrite: When true, replaces any existing file at that path with a new empty workbook, discarding its contents permanently. Defaults to false, which fails instead.

get-workbook.name: get-workbook
get-workbook.description: Get an Excel workbook: its file metadata and the list of worksheets it contains. Confirms the item is a usable .xlsx — this is the only tool that validates the extension when addressing by itemId, because it is the only one that fetches the item metadata; the others surface Graph's own error for a wrong item type.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root, e.g. "Finance/Budget.xlsx". Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

calculate-workbook.name: calculate-workbook
calculate-workbook.description: Force Excel to recalculate a workbook. Use after writing formulas if dependent cells still show stale values.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.calculationType: Calculation scope: "Recalculate" (default, changed cells only), "Full", or "FullRebuild".

list-worksheets.name: list-worksheets
list-worksheets.description: List every worksheet in an Excel workbook, with its position and visibility.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

add-worksheet.name: add-worksheet
add-worksheet.description: Add a new worksheet to an Excel workbook.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.name: Name for the new worksheet. Excel assigns one if omitted.

delete-worksheet.name: delete-worksheet
delete-worksheet.description: Delete a worksheet and everything on it. This cannot be undone by this app — the workbook must be restored from OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.worksheet: Worksheet name or id to delete

rename-worksheet.name: rename-worksheet
rename-worksheet.description: Rename a worksheet, or change its position or visibility.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

read-range.name: read-range
read-range.description: Read a range of cells from a worksheet. Returns raw values, display text, and the underlying formulas.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Range in A1 notation, e.g. "A1:C10" or "B2".

read-used-range.name: read-used-range
read-used-range.description: Read every populated cell on a worksheet without knowing its extent in advance. Use this to survey a sheet before reading specific ranges.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.valuesOnly: When true, ignore cells that carry only formatting, so the range covers just cells with values.

write-range.name: write-range
write-range.description: Write cells into a worksheet range. Writes literal values by default; set formulas:true to write formula strings such as "=A1*B1". Pass a single cell like "A1" as the address and the range auto-expands to match the values array — no need to calculate the exact range dimensions. Set append:true to write at the first empty row after the used range, ignoring address. This app does not manage workbook sessions: each call runs as its own implicit session and there is no batching, so prefer one write over a wide range to many small ones.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Range in A1 notation, e.g. "A1:C10". A single cell like "A1" auto-expands to match the values array. Ignored when append is true.
params.values: Rows of cells, e.g. [["Item","Cost"],["Widget",9.5]]. Every row must be the same length.
params.formulas: When true, the payload is written as formulas rather than literal values (default: false).
params.append: When true, write at the first empty row after the used range. The address parameter is ignored (only the worksheet is used). Useful for building a sheet incrementally without tracking row offsets.

clear-range.name: clear-range
clear-range.description: Clear a range: its contents, its formatting, or both. This cannot be undone by this app.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

sort-range.name: sort-range
sort-range.description: Sort a range by one or more columns. Column indexes are zero-based and relative to the range, not the sheet.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.sortBy: Sort keys applied in order. Each entry is { column: <zero-based index within the range>, ascending?: boolean } — ascending defaults to true.
params.hasHeaders: When true, the first row is treated as headers and is not sorted.

format-range.name: format-range
format-range.description: Apply number formatting and cell styling to a range: currency or date formats, bold, italic, font size and colour, fill colour, and alignment.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.numberFormat: Excel number format applied to every cell in the range, e.g. "$#,##0.00", "0.0%", "yyyy-mm-dd".
params.fontColor: Font colour as a hex string, e.g. "#C00000"
params.fillColor: Cell background colour as a hex string, e.g. "#FFF2CC"

insert-rows-or-columns.name: insert-rows-or-columns
insert-rows-or-columns.description: Insert blank rows or columns at a range, shifting existing cells out of the way. Use a whole-row address like "3:4" or a whole-column address like "B:B" to insert entire rows or columns.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Where to insert, in A1 notation. "3:4" inserts two rows at row 3; "B:B" inserts one column at B.

delete-rows-or-columns.name: delete-rows-or-columns
delete-rows-or-columns.description: Delete rows or columns at a range, shifting the surviving cells to close the gap. This cannot be undone by this app.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: What to delete, in A1 notation. "5:6" deletes rows 5 and 6; "B:B" deletes column B.

list-tables.name: list-tables
list-tables.description: List every Excel table in a workbook, across all worksheets. Table names address the add-table-rows tool.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

add-table.name: add-table
add-table.description: Turn a range of cells into an Excel table, so it can be appended to, sorted and filtered as a unit.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Range to convert, in A1 notation, e.g. "A1:C10".
params.hasHeaders: Whether the first row of the range holds column headers (default: true).

add-table-rows.name: add-table-rows
add-table-rows.description: Append rows to an Excel table. The table grows automatically — no need to find the next free row.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.table: Table name or id, as returned by list-tables. Pass the literal name, not a pre-encoded one.
params.values: Rows to append, e.g. [["Widget",9.5],["Gadget",12]]. Each row must have one cell per table column.
params.index: Optional zero-based position to insert at. Appends to the end when omitted.

add-chart.name: add-chart
add-chart.description: Add a chart to a worksheet from a range of data. Use get-chart-image afterwards to see the result.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.worksheet: Worksheet name or id the chart is added to
params.sourceData: Range supplying the chart data, in A1 notation, e.g. "A1:B10".
params.seriesBy: Whether each series comes from "Columns" (default), "Rows", or "Auto".

get-chart-image.name: get-chart-image
get-chart-image.description: Render a chart as a PNG image, returned base64-encoded. Use this to visually check a chart you created. Pass width and height to keep the image small — a render over 5 MB is rejected.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.worksheet: Worksheet name or id holding the chart
params.chart: Chart name or id, e.g. "Chart 1". Pass the literal name, not a pre-encoded one.

list-charts.name: list-charts
list-charts.description: List all charts in a worksheet, with their name, type, and source data range.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

delete-chart.name: delete-chart
delete-chart.description: Delete a chart from a worksheet by its name or id. Use list-charts first to find the chart name.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.chart: Chart name or id, e.g. "Chart 1". Pass the literal name, not a pre-encoded one.

merge-cells.name: merge-cells
merge-cells.description: Merge a range of cells into a single cell. Use unmerge:true to split a merged cell back into individual cells. Orientation controls how cells are combined: "all" (default) merges everything into one cell, "across" merges each row separately, "down" merges each column separately.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.orientation: How to merge: "all" (default, everything into one cell), "across" (each row merged separately), or "down" (each column merged separately). Ignored when unmerge is true.
params.unmerge: When true, unmerge the range instead of merging it. The orientation parameter is ignored.

set-column-width.name: set-column-width
set-column-width.description: Set the width of one or more columns, or auto-fit them to their contents. Pass a column range like "A:C" or a single column like "A" as the address. Omit width to auto-fit the columns to their content.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Column range in A1 notation, e.g. "A:C" for columns A through C, or "A" for a single column. Use the column letters only — no row numbers.
params.width: Column width in Excel units (approximately the width of one character). Omit to auto-fit the columns to their content.

set-row-height.name: set-row-height
set-row-height.description: Set the height of one or more rows, or auto-fit them to their contents. Pass a row range like "1:10" or a single row like "1" as the address. Omit height to auto-fit the rows to their content.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Row range in A1 notation, e.g. "1:10" for rows 1 through 10, or "1" for a single row. Use the row numbers only — no column letters.
params.height: Row height in points. Omit to auto-fit the rows to their content.

add-borders.name: add-borders
add-borders.description: Apply borders to a range. Each border specifies a side (EdgeTop, EdgeBottom, EdgeLeft, EdgeRight, InsideHorizontal, InsideVertical), a style (None, Continuous, Dash, DashDot, DashDotDot, Dotted, Double, SlantDashDot), and an optional colour as a hex string.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.borders: Array of border definitions. Each entry is { side, style, color? }. side: EdgeTop, EdgeBottom, EdgeLeft, EdgeRight, InsideHorizontal, InsideVertical. style: None, Continuous, Dash, DashDot, DashDotDot, Dotted, Double, SlantDashDot. color: hex string like "#000000".

add-conditional-format.name: add-conditional-format
add-conditional-format.description: Add a conditional formatting rule to a range. Rule types: CellValue (compare cell values with operator + formula), ColorScale (3-color gradient), DataBar (in-cell data bars), IconSet (icon-based), TopBottom (top/bottom N), Custom (formula-based). Use list:true to list existing rules on the range, or deleteIndex to delete a rule by its zero-based index.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.list: When true, list all conditional formatting rules on the range instead of adding one.
params.deleteIndex: When set, delete the conditional formatting rule at this zero-based index instead of adding one.
params.formula: Formula or value for the rule, e.g. "0" for CellValue GreaterThan 0. For TopBottom, use a number like "10" for top 10.
params.fill: Fill format for the rule, e.g. { color: "#FF0000" }.
params.font: Font format for the rule, e.g. { color: "#FFFFFF", bold: true }.

set-data-validation.name: set-data-validation
set-data-validation.description: Set data validation rules on a range — dropdown lists, number constraints, date ranges, text length limits, or custom formulas. Use clear:true to remove all data validation from the range.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.clear: When true, remove all data validation from the range.
params.operator: Comparison operator: "GreaterThan", "GreaterThanOrEqual", "LessThan", "LessThanOrEqual", "Between", "NotBetween", "EqualTo", "NotEqualTo". Required for all types except List and Custom.
params.formula1: First formula or value. For List, a comma-separated list like "Yes,No,Maybe" or a range reference like "=Sheet1!A1:A10". For other types, the comparison value.
params.prompt: Input prompt shown when the cell is selected.
params.errorAlert: Error message shown when invalid data is entered.

add-comment.name: add-comment
add-comment.description: Add a comment to a cell, or list / delete / update comments on a worksheet. Use list:true to list all comments, deleteId to delete a comment by its id, or updateId + content to update a comment.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.cell: Target cell in A1 notation, e.g. "A1". Required when adding a comment.
params.content: Comment text. Required when adding or updating a comment.
params.list: When true, list all comments on the worksheet.
params.deleteId: When set, delete the comment with this id.
params.updateId: When set, update the comment with this id. Requires content.

add-hyperlink.name: add-hyperlink
add-hyperlink.description: Add a clickable hyperlink to a cell. This writes an Excel =HYPERLINK() formula into the target cell, which is the method supported by the Microsoft Graph Excel REST API. The cell displays the friendly text and links to the URL when clicked.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.address: Target cell in A1 notation, e.g. "A1".
params.url: The URL to link to, e.g. "https://example.com".
params.displayText: Text to display in the cell instead of the raw URL. Defaults to the URL.

protect-sheet.name: protect-sheet
protect-sheet.description: Protect a worksheet to prevent accidental edits, or remove protection. Use unprotect:true to unprotect the sheet. When protecting, you can optionally specify allowed operations.

params.itemId: Workbook drive item ID. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Workbook path relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.unprotect: When true, remove protection from the worksheet instead of applying it.
params.allowFormatCells: Allow formatting cells while protected (default: false).
params.allowInsertColumns: Allow inserting columns while protected (default: false).
params.allowInsertRows: Allow inserting rows while protected (default: false).
params.allowDeleteColumns: Allow deleting columns while protected (default: false).
params.allowDeleteRows: Allow deleting rows while protected (default: false).
params.allowAutoFilter: Allow using auto-filter while protected (default: false).

name: Excel
description: Microsoft Graph API를 통한 Microsoft Excel 통합

changelog.notes: 초기 릴리스 — Microsoft Graph를 통해 Excel 범위, 수식, 표 및 차트 읽기 및 쓰기
